plain_description.what: Computes a stricter threshold that controls errors across all model pairs at once, from existing resamples on four boards. It then counts how many model orderings survive it. No judge calls.
plain_description.why: Checks whether the published tier maps of models still hold when many pairwise comparisons are corrected for together.
plain_description.information: A big loss of orderings would weaken the leaderboard tiers. Little loss would confirm them. Result: delivered as a readout. The predicted 15-25% drop only appears under a mixed reading that compares quantities on different scales. Under consistent readings the drop is at most 14%, and the main tier map does not change. Which statistic the framework rule should use is still open. This test belongs to the older question pool, so it now counts as history, not evidence.
